behavioral_corrections: Evaluate terminal-review policy before execution-key filter construction and before either scheduler mutator can run.
Default the scheduler executor to blocking every mutating group when terminal review is present, while preserving explicit review and blocked-work evidence.
Wire daemon stop_on_terminal_review to the pre-mutation executor fence and expose the decision through aggregate, heartbeat, and operator JSON evidence.
Validate queue-state, ownership, expiry, retry, chunk, lease, and mutation-key relationships before action authority is minted.
Independently validate scheduler group metadata inside the executor rather than trusting the adjacent policy implementation.
Fix the sanitizer CMake path by applying PRIVATE options to concrete selftest libraries instead of an INTERFACE aggregate.
summary: Fence terminal review before mutation, extract a pure scheduler policy and runtime executor, and record the unresolved daemon-owner fencing gap.
